name: Bogota
summary: At 2,640 meters above sea level, Bogotá offers an almost constant temperate climate all year round and a rapidly growing technological and digital nomad scene, especially in Chapinero and Zona G. It is one of the most affordable capitals in South America, with an increasingly consolidated cultural, gastronomic and coworking offer.
